measurement.clock: retained applicationRun through complete Flight; JSON and exact validation outside timer

caveat: Prior and current candidate binaries are compared under the same actual Fast/SinglePass Wasmtime settings against one retained Node 24 module. The source revision and binary identities bind each build; the difference is descriptive and is not isolated causal evidence for any single source change. Process medians are units; no significance claim.

source_identity.git_revision_role: base commit only; compiler fingerprint and executable/program/runtime hashes identify measured builds

measured_source.role: Final private-local-promotion candidate; apply tracked patch then new files to base. Earlier inline-cell candidate remains frozen as a separate diagnostic.

baseline_source.note: Verified prior public candidate identity, archive hash/size and source manifest; raw aggregate retains its original stale filename string.

configuration.target_features_policy: explicit Config::target disables host-inferred feature flags
